findings.heading: Combinations analysis / Biểu đồ kết hợp
findings.proposition: The horizontal bars showing the frequency of each individual symptom are located on the RIGHT of the UpSet plot; the Vietnamese says they are on the left ("Ở bên trái").
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader looking at the example UpSet plot searches the left-hand side for the per-symptom frequency bars, finds the set-size bars are not where the text says, and may mis-read the horizontal bars they do find (or the vertical combination bars) as the wrong quantity.

findings.heading: `UpSetR`
findings.proposition: The `+()` function converts values to 1s and 0s based on a logical statement.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader is shown `~+(.x == "yes")` with no explanation of what the leading `+` does, so they cannot tell that it is the operator performing the logical-to-numeric coercion, and cannot adapt the idiom to another condition or another dataset.

findings.heading: `UpSetR`
findings.proposition: The `across()` + `+()` command is offered as a MORE EFFICIENT alternative to the preceding per-column `case_when()`/`ifelse()` block ("If you are interested in a more efficient command").
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader sees the second chunk as an unmotivated extra example rather than a recommended shorter replacement for the five repeated per-column recodes, and keeps writing the long form.
